network_snapshots.parquet.description: Pairwise audience overlap snapshots across yearly, cumulative, and all-time windows.

columns.window_start: Window opening boundary timestamp (UTC ISO format).
columns.window_end: Window closing boundary timestamp (UTC ISO format).
columns.vtuber_a: First VTuber channel ID (lexicographically ordered: vtuber_a < vtuber_b).
columns.shared_any: Count of distinct pseudonymized viewers active in both channels during the window.
columns.shared_comments: Count of distinct pseudonymized commenters active in both channels.
columns.shared_live_chat: Count of distinct pseudonymized live chatters active in both channels.
columns.strong_shared_any: Count of viewers observed across >=2 distinct videos on both channels.
columns.strong_shared_comments: Count of commenters observed across >=2 distinct videos on both channels.
columns.strong_shared_live_chat: Count of chatters observed across >=2 distinct streams on both channels.
columns.jaccard_comments: Jaccard similarity coefficient based on unique commenting audience.
columns.jaccard_live_chat: Jaccard similarity coefficient based on unique live chat audience.
columns.overlap_coefficient: Szymkiewicz-Simpson overlap coefficient: shared_any / min(size_a, size_b).
columns.size_a: Total distinct active audience size for vtuber_a in the window.
columns.size_b: Total distinct active audience size for vtuber_b in the window.
columns.coverage_a: Mathematical observation completeness indicator for vtuber_a (1.0 or 0.0).
columns.coverage_b: Mathematical observation completeness indicator for vtuber_b (1.0 or 0.0).

yearly_ecosystem_metrics.parquet.description: Macro-level topological graph metrics for each yearly slice (2020-2026).

columns.active_channels: Count of active VTuber channels with >=1 co-attendance edge.
columns.edges: Count of pairwise audience co-attendance links.
columns.modularity: Louvain community modularity Q score at resolution=1.0.
columns.community_count: Number of detected Louvain community partitions.
columns.agency_at_selection_assortativity: Newman assortativity coefficient by agency status at selection time.
columns.agency_at_selection_independent_mixing: Proportion of cross-agency edges connecting unaffiliated creators.
columns.cross_community_edge_share: Proportion of graph edges crossing community partition boundaries.

yearly_centrality.parquet.description: Per-channel node centrality metrics across calendar slices.

columns.channel_id: Public YouTube channel ID of the VTuber.
columns.degree: Unweighted node degree (number of connected peer channels).

bridge_dynamics.parquet.description: Cross-community bridging dynamics and threshold perturbation stability.

columns.threshold_th5_retention_ratio: Degree retention ratio under threshold=5 perturbation.

yearly_evidence_quality.parquet.description: Tiered evidence collection quality, truncation, and coverage metrics.

columns.total_interactions: Total interaction events with valid interaction_time.
columns.catalog_channels_active: Total channels active in catalog during the year (N_cat,yr).
columns.cohort_population_coverage_rate: Active cohort coverage rate against cumulative active population.
columns.high_comment_volume_rate: Proportion of sampled videos with >=95 comments.
columns.partial_capture_videos: Count of videos terminating with partial capture.
columns.t6_deepened_resolved_videos: Count of historical videos deepened and resolved by Phase T6 exhaustive capture.
columns.unresolved_cap_exposure_videos: Count of unexhausted videos exposed to comment caps (empirically 0).

community_lineage_v2.parquet.description: Longitudinal community lineage graph based on global maximum-weight bipartite matching.

columns.is_primary_backbone: Boolean flag indicating primary one-to-one continuation link.
